Alexandria municipal pages were also found, but no current anonymous Al-Asafra parcel viewer, feature service, schema, CRS, or geometry endpoint was identified.

queries.result: Arabic search found the official Egyptian Survey Authority pages, including digital and topographic map products, and official Alexandria references to Al-Asafra and the Alexandria Survey Directorate. These sources do not expose an anonymous parcel layer, native parcel identifier schema, CRS, or geometry API.

registryBasis: The Egyptian Survey Authority is evidenced as the national surveying and mapping custodian, and Alexandria municipal material references the local Survey Directorate. No Al-Asafra-specific local registry office, public cadastral viewer, or anonymous parcel service was independently evidenced.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Official national survey authority; describes production of property/land maps, cadastral responsibilities, and an Alexandria digital-map project, but publishes no anonymous parcel API on the inspected page.

geometryDecision: No GeoJSON retained. No safe anonymous native parcel ID-plus-geometry response was available from an official Al-Asafra/Alexandria service; the exact WUP point was not used to infer absence.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or survey identity if publicly exposed
remainingUncertainty: ESA and Alexandria custodians are evidenced, but a current public parcel-service URL, parcel-layer schema, CRS, exact-point inclusion, and citywide coverage remain unverified. CAPMAS availability is also unresolved after timeout.
nextStep: A serial reviewer should independently check whether the Egyptian Survey Authority, Alexandria Survey Directorate, or CAPMAS exposes a current anonymous parcel/map endpoint, then qualify a small geometry-only sample before any adapter consideration.
